Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. children under 18, created by the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act". Children born between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2028, receive a $1,000 government seed deposit. Parents can open accounts via IRS Form 4547 or at TrumpAccounts.gov, with 5 million already registered as of April 2026. IRS Form 4547 TrumpAccounts.gov Key Features of Trump Accounts: Funding: $1,000 pilot contribution for 2025–2028 births. Contributions: Parents, relatives, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 annually. Investments: Funds are invested in ETFs/mutual funds, typically tracking the S&P 500. Withdrawals: Funds grow tax-deferred and are locked until the child turns 18. Conversion: At age 18, the account converts to a traditional IRA. How to Participate Eligibility: Children must have a Social Security number. Opening: Accounts can be established on TrumpAccounts.gov or by filing IRS Form 4547. TrumpAccounts.gov IRS Form 4547 Launch Date: Contributions begin July 4, 2026.
